title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator (Temporary)

Location: Birmingham City Centre
Contract Type: Temporary

Pay: £13.30 - £13.84 per hour depending on experience

Our client, is seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Accounts Administrator to join their dynamic team in Birmingham City Centre. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and possess a passion for financial administration.

Key Responsibilities:
- Raising, processing and reconciling invoices and credit notes, ensuring all records are accurate and compliant with company procedures.
- Allocating incoming payments and maintaining up-to-date financial records.
- Monitoring outstanding accounts and proactively following up to secure prompt payment.
- Assisting with financial reporting and data analysis to support business decision-making.
- Managing the billing process for fee earners, including processing chargeable time, handling billing queries, and updating fee allocations, transfers and write-offs.
- Supporting the production of annual client statements, ensuring accuracy and attention to detail.
- Assisting with year-end financial activities and preparing documentation for audits.
- Providing general administrative and ad hoc support to the wider finance team as required.

About You

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused professional who can work confidently in a fast-paced office environment. You'll ideally have:
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- Experience using finance or practice management systems, ideally Xero and/or Clio.
- Experience within an finance support or accounts-based role.
- Excellent organisational skills, a proactive approach and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.

If you are ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role as an Accounts Administrator, contributing to the success of a forward-thinking organisation, this opportunity is for you!

Don't miss out on the chance to join our client's successful team. Apply now or email for more information and take the next step in your career!

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
A forward-thinking and highly regarded professional services business is seeking an experienced and motivated Accounts Assistant to join its collaborative finance team. Working closely with experienced members of the finance team, you will gain valuable hands-on experience across a broad range of finance responsibilities while developing your technical knowledge and professional skills. Responsibilities will include processing invoices, assisting with bank reconciliations, supporting accounts payable and receivable, preparing journals, maintaining accurate financial records, assisting with month-end processes, reconciling balance sheet accounts, supporting management accounts preparation, and working closely with senior finance professionals on a variety of finance projects. This role offers excellent exposure within a fast-paced professional services environment, providing the perfect opportunity for someone with existing finance experience to continue developing their career.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within a finance or accounts environment, across purchase ledger and sales ledger.
- Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to accurately reconcile financial information.
- A confident, professional, and personable approach with excellent communication skills in order to work in a highly client facing role.
- A hardworking attitude, strong work ethic, and genuine ambition to build a successful career within finance and accountancy.

In return, you will receive:
- Full study support towards a professional accounting qualification
- Hybrid working and a modern, collaborative office environment
- Excellent career progression with strong long-term development opportunities, including outstanding training, mentoring, and exposure to experienced finance professionals
- Regular team socials and a supportive culture where you'll work alongside ambitious, like-minded professionals

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant looking to take the next step in your finance career and are keen to join a supportive, fast-paced environment that will invest in your future, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now!

Accounts Assistant Temporary, Hybrid Midlands

Trinity House Group are recruiting a Temporary Accounts Assistant for a well established organisation in Birmingham whose finance function is in the middle of an exciting period of transformation. This is a hands on transactional finance role covering cashbook, purchase ledger and sales invoicing, ideal for someone who is switched on, detail focused and ready to get stuck in quickly.

About the role
The business has grown significantly over many years and its finance team is now simplifying processes and preparing to move onto new CRM and finance systems. You will join a supportive team, with a structured four week induction, and help clear processing volume so the wider team can focus on improvement. This is an initial six month temporary assignment with genuine potential to become permanent as the new structure takes shape.

Key responsibilities
- Posting cashbook transactions and updating remittances.
- Entering purchase invoices onto the purchase day book.
- Raising sales invoices and supporting the online jobs board.
- Raising purchase orders on request from the operations team.
- Managing payments on account and matching to invoices.
- Checking and reconciling your own work to keep the ledgers accurate.

What we are looking for
- Strong common sense, a logical mindset and excellent attention to detail.
- Someone who is confident asking questions and comfortable in a fast paced, changing environment.
- Experience as an Accounts Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Finance Assistant or similar is helpful, but not essential if you learn quickly.
- Sage 50 experience is a bonus. Full training is provided.
- No formal accounting qualifications required.

Why apply
- Flexible hybrid working, settling to two days a week in the office.
- Flexible start and finish times, with part time hours considered (great for school hours).
- Temp to perm potential in a finance team that is modernising.
- Quick process: short call followed by a paid trial session, with starts from mid October.

If you are an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant looking for an immediate temporary role in Birmingham, apply today or get in touch for a confidential chat.

The Edgbaston Village Metro stop, which serves as the current terminus for the West Midlands Metro tram line us located directly outside the front of the building.

title: Finance Officer
description:
Robertson Bell is supporting a growing Academy Trust to recruit a Finance Officer to join its finance team. Created due to continued growth and increased demand on the existing team, this is a broad operational finance role offering significant flexibility around working patterns and the opportunity to develop within a collaborative environment.

The Role

You will have exposure to a wide range of finance processes, including:
- Managing the finance inbox, orders through the finance system, invoices and credit card controls.
- Completing bank reconciliations and supporting payment processing.
- Running weekly payment processes and issuing remittances.
- Processing payroll changes, journals, reconciliations, PAYE and pensions.
- Raising lettings invoices, supporting VAT claims and monthly management accounts.
- Supporting pension returns, budget uploads, DfE returns and other finance activity.
- Assisting with contract reviews, audits, insurance and leasing agreements.

The breadth of the role means you will have the opportunity to take ownership of different areas of finance, learn new processes and build your experience beyond traditional transactional finance. As the organisation continues to grow, there is also scope for the role to develop with it.

The Person

The successful candidate will be looking for an opportunity to develop their skills within a collaborative organisation.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in a Finance Officer, Finance Assistant or similar finance role.
- A good understanding of core finance processes, including invoicing, reconciliations and payments.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to work with different stakeholders.
- The curiosity and willingness to learn that will allow you to take on new areas of responsibility.
- Education sector experience is helpful but not essential.

Next Steps

This is an opportunity to join a growing education organisation where relationships, collaboration and personal development are valued, while gaining broad exposure across an established finance function.

For further information or to apply, please apply to the role.
